name: Prompt Variants B vs C (Blind)
description: Blind A/B of prompt variants B_consonants vs C_call_response. Axis 1: melody + music. Axis 2: mix + diction. Plus a check that the backing choir actually answers the lead.

criteria.label: Overall quality
criteria.help: Your gut call on the whole take.

criteria.label: [Melody & Music] Melody / maqam fit
criteria.help: Does the vocal line sit in the intended maqam and mood (see maqam in the run notes)? Is it memorable, not wandering?

criteria.label: [Melody & Music] Arrangement / instrumentation
criteria.help: Guitars, orchestral strings, drums: does the band sound cohesive, powerful and in character (symphonic rock/metal), with sensible build and structure?

criteria.label: [Mix & Diction] Mix balance
criteria.help: Vocal forward but not detached? Band not burying the voice? Reverb tight, no mud, no harshness.

criteria.label: [Mix & Diction] Diction / consonant clarity
criteria.help: Can you follow the Arabic words? Consonants crisp, no slurring or swallowed syllables.

criteria.label: Backing choir answers the lead?
criteria.help: Listen for a group / choir responding after the lead line (call and response). Rate what you hear, not what you expect.

criteria.label: Notes
criteria.help: Anything worth remembering (timestamps, wrong word, choir timing, takes off).
